args.query: MATCH (p:Player {name: 'Roger Federer'})-[:WON|:LOST]->(m:Match)-[:PART_OF]->(t:Tournament {name: 'Wimbledon'}) RETURN m.id AS match_id, m.duration AS minutes, m.round AS round, m.opponent AS opponent_name ORDER BY minutes DESC LIMIT 1

MATCH (p:Player {name: "Roger Federer"})-[:WON|:LOST]->(m:Match)-[:PART_OF]->(t:Tournament {name: "Wimbledon"}) MATCH (opp:Player)-[:WON|:LOST]->(m) WHERE opp <> p RETURN m.minutes AS minutes, opp.name AS opponent ORDER BY minutes DESC LIMIT 1

MATCH (p:Player {name: "Roger Federer"})-[:WON|:LOST]->(m:Match)-[:PART_OF]->(t:Tournament {name: "Wimbledon"}) MATCH (opp:Player)-[:WON|:LOST]->(m) WHERE opp <> p RETURN m.minutes AS minutes, opp.name AS opponent ORDER BY minutes DESC LIMIT 1

MATCH (p:Player {name: "Roger Federer"})-[:WON|:LOST]->(m:Match)-[:PART_OF]->(t:Tournament {name: "Wimbledon"}) MATCH (opp:Player)-[:WON|:LOST]->(m) WHERE opp <> p RETURN m.id AS matchId, m.minutes AS minutes, opp.name AS opponent ORDER BY minutes DESC LIMIT 5

MATCH (p:Player {name: "Roger Federer"})-[:WON|:LOST]->(m:Match)-[:PART_OF]->(t:Tournament {name: "Wimbledon"}) WHERE exists(m.minutes) RETURN m.id AS id, m.minutes AS minutes ORDER BY minutes DESC LIMIT 10

MATCH (p:Player {name: "Roger Federer"})-[:WON|:LOST]->(m:Match)-[:PART_OF]->(t:Tournament {name: "Wimbledon"}) WHERE m.minutes IS NOT NULL RETURN m.id AS id, m.minutes AS minutes, m.round AS round ORDER BY minutes DESC LIMIT 10
